text: Branch final-v3-experiments created from final-v3 (81813de); decoder-improvement-v1-experiments merged with a real merge commit (236ab49). Only README.md conflicted; rl/ and configs/rl_feedback.json byte-identical to rl-v2-experiments.

Workspace: the earlier project filer directories were purged on 2026-11-13, so a new filer workspace /data/rtxw01/nbak/robot_intel/kztrgg/projs/code/csci642-v3 was created (git init + fetch of this repository; no clone, no disconnected history). RL env venv/rl rebuilt with conda python=3.12.3 + pip install -r rl/requirements-lock.cluster.txt (same lock as v2); OSMesa prefix gl/ = conda-forge mesalib 24.3. v2 validation suites (w=0.1, 0.5) and the v2 final suite are restored from their Releases with hash checks (scripts/final_v3_restore_suite.py).

Stage 1 (sensitivity) runs from a commit whose RL training sources (rl/train.py, environment.py, feedback.py, checkpoint.py) are byte-identical to the v2 final commit 25bb0f4, so sparse/dense must reproduce the v2 final runs exactly. The protocol-v3 and preference code is committed only afterwards.

Sensitivity protocols w=0.1 and w=0.5 frozen with rl.freeze from their existing complete v2 validation suites (restored from rl-v2-validation-w010/-w050 Releases; every archive and file hash checked; not rerun). Rationale string exactly as in the handoff. Evidence runs equal reports/rl_v2_validation/candidate_*/runs.csv. Status: post-hoc sensitivity analysis requested after the v2 final results; the v2 primary result (w=1.0) is unchanged; not a re-selection.

Decoder test suite: tests.test_dimp + tests.test_closeout run in a new Python 3.11 env from requirements-lock.txt with the documented NCCL reinstall (reports/decoder_improvement/REPRODUCE.md) -> 31 tests OK; tests.test_feedback_vnext runs in the RL env as documented -> 35 tests OK (with rl.test_stage2), 1 skipped. Finding (pre-existing, not changed): scripts/download_feedback.py --profile rl_feedback_vnext.json reports 'Unexpected CSV schema' because the vnext tables carry 3 extra columns (recipe_id, p_error_temperature, margin); all vnext asset sizes/SHA-256 matched and FeedbackLibrary loads them (the vnext profile is unused for RL).

v3 selection rule declared in FINAL_V3_HANDOFF.md 6.3 and implemented as scripts/rl_select_candidate.py --metric auc (committed a09817f before any v3 validation run). v3 smoke passed (all seven conditions, reload, continuation) at a09817f. v3 validation suites v3_w050/w100/w200 (33 runs each, s11/s13, seeds 100-102) launched from a09817f.

Preference geometry check passed at a09817f on 100 evaluation + 3 trajectory goals (straight-line scripted controller violates on all 103 goals, pillar entry 103/103; left-detour reaches every goal without violation; 2060 labeled segments match the label definitions). Preference smoke passed. Pilots launched: sparse, dense, ideal, eegnet s11, cbramod s13 x seeds 900/901, w=1.0, 150k steps, geometry R=0.025 m, corridor a in [0.25, 0.75].

Operational: a submission call timed out after submitting the v3_validation_w200 jobs; a resubmission queued every w200 run a second time. The 33 later duplicates were killed while pending (none started); one job per planned run remains.

Pilot gate operationalized before any pilot result: 'ideal clearly higher than sparse' = mean final-policy preferred-pass rate of ideal (seeds 900/901) exceeds that of sparse by at least 0.20, AND ideal exceeds sparse on both pilot seeds (seed-matched). If it fails, only pillar radius, corridor bounds or budget may change, judged on ideal/sparse pilots only (EEG pilots never consulted), each change logged here before validation.

Operational: the same timed-out submission call had also submitted the 10 preference pilots (jobs 8392217-8392226); the later duplicate submission (8392261-8392270) exited within seconds with FileExistsError on the existing run directories, so no pilot ran twice and no run directory was touched. Side effect: each duplicate's shell redirect truncated the pilot's top-level stdout log runs/pref_pilots/<run>.log; the run directories (run.json, status.json, transitions, evaluations, checkpoints) are unaffected. Pilots are diagnostic only.

Pilot gate round 1 FAILED (R=0.025 m, corridor a in [0.25,0.75], 150k steps, w=1.0): mean final preferred-pass rate ideal 0.03 (seeds 900/901: 0.00, 0.06) vs sparse 0.03 (0.02, 0.04); ideal did not exceed sparse on both seeds. EEG pilots (eegnet s11, cbramod s13) were completed but are not consulted for the gate. Pillar radius cannot be increased (R=0.025 is the maximum keeping the pillar edge >= 5 cm from start and goal at D >= 0.15). Declared before any round-2 result, in order of preference (smallest change first): G1 original geometry with budget 300k; G2 corridor a in [0.10,0.90] at 150k; G3 corridor a in [0.10,0.90] at 300k. Each runs ideal + sparse at pilot seeds 900/901 only. The first variant in this order that passes the declared gate (ideal - sparse >= 0.20 and ideal > sparse on both seeds) becomes the preference geometry/budget for validation and final; if none passes, G3 is used and the gate failure is reported (the study continues as a documented negative pilot outcome).

v3 validation complete (3 x 33 runs, all summarize OK). Declared AUC rule selected v3_w050 (mean normalized success AUC over the 12 EEGNet+CBraMod runs: w0.5 0.7551, w1.0 0.7130, w2.0 0.6422). Frozen with rl.freeze; protocol + evidence + selection committed under configs/final_v3/v3_frozen/ before the v3 final suite.

Stage 1 complete: 2 x 75 sensitivity final runs (f63dc24), no failures, summarize OK. Determinism check: all 10 sparse/dense runs of each sensitivity suite have identical evaluation.json, evaluation histories, transition logs and final inference probes to the v2 final runs.
v3 final complete: 75/75 runs from 41109cb (frozen w=0.5), no failures, summarize OK; analysis, trajectories (representative + all 75 final policies) and 7 GIFs (replay matches recording) generated.

Pilot gate round 2: no declared variant passed (final preferred-pass, ideal vs sparse: G2 0.06 vs 0.03; G3 0.065 vs 0.035; G1 ideal 0.09, which cannot pass the 0.20 margin whatever its last sparse run gives). Per the rule declared before round 2, the fallback G3 is the preference protocol: corridor a in [0.10, 0.90], 300,000 steps, R = 0.025 m. configs/final_v3/pref_candidates/pref_w{100,200,400}.json regenerated with this geometry/budget (pref_w100 is byte-identical to the G3 pilot config). The gate failure is reported; validation/final run as declared.

Preference plan committed before validation: reports/final_v3/preference_plan.md (candidates w 1/2/4, selection = highest mean final preferred-pass over the 12 EEGNet+CBraMod validation runs, ties by task success then smaller weight; scripts/rl_select_candidate.py --metric preferred_pass).
